name: matlab-generate-code
description: Generate, verify, refine, and accelerate C/C++ or CUDA code from MATLAB with MATLAB Coder, Embedded Coder, GPU Coder, or MATLAB Test. Also covers writing codegen-ready MATLAB code: language constraints, coder.* directives, and optimization patterns. Triggers on: codegen, MEX, deploy MATLAB as C/C++, GPU Coder, coder.screener, coder.config, coder.gpuConfig, coder.typeof, coder.runTest, matlabtest.coder.TestCase, SIL, embedded config, no dynamic memory, EnableMexProfiling, coder.timeit, coder.perfCompare, %#codegen, writing codegen-ready MATLAB, code generation readiness, coder.varsize, coder.unroll, coder.noImplicitExpansionInFunction, coder.ceval, coder.inline, coder.extrinsic, coder.const, coder.classSignature, class codegen limitations, temporal types codegen, DMA-off, stack-only, host-target InstructionSetExtensions, SIMDAcceleration, OptimizeReductions, host SIMD tuning, host OpenMP, codegen performance.
